title: Achieving a European Banking Union without increasing risks
title_zh: 在不增加风险的前提下实现欧洲银行业联盟
authors: Gyöngyi Lóránth, Anatoli Segura, Jing Zeng
official: 官方在线 2026-07-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: European banking remains fragmented, leaving billions of euros inefficiently allocated. Reforms to establish a European deposit insurance system have been proposed to allow cross-border banking groups to operate more freely. This column argues that a common deposit insurance system fundamentally changes the link between risk-sharing and risk-taking. In addition to greater integration, it can encourage more risk-taking, with unclear effects on overall welfare. Therefore, greater freedom to move capital and liquidity across borders should be accompanied by sufficiently strict supervision to address the risk-taking incentives created by such reforms.
abstract_zh: 欧洲银行业仍处于碎片化状态，导致数十亿欧元资金配置效率低下。为建立欧洲存款保险体系而提出的改革方案，旨在允许跨境银行集团更自由地运营。本专栏认为，共同存款保险体系从根本上改变了风险分担与风险承担之间的关联。除了促进一体化外，它还可能鼓励更多风险承担行为，但对整体福利的影响尚不明确。因此，在赋予资本和流动性跨境流动更大自由度的同时，必须辅以足够严格的监管，以应对此类改革所催生的风险承担激励。

title: Innovation through Inventor Mobility: Evidence from Non-Compete Agreements
title_zh: 发明人流动性与创新：基于竞业禁止协议的证据
authors: Reinmuth, Kate, Rockall, Emma
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Proponents of labor mobility restrictions argue that innovation incentives more than offset harm to workers. Yet the causal effect of such policies on innovation is an open empirical question. Leveraging plausibly exogenous state-level changes in the enforceability of noncompete agreements, we find a significant negative effect on innovation. This effect is even larger for the most novel and innovative patents and firms. Further analysis shows that these negative effects on innovation cannot be explained by entry alone and instead likely result from reduced knowledge flows. Our findings suggest that labor mobility plays a crucial role in spreading knowledge across firms.
abstract_zh: 劳动力流动限制的支持者认为，创新激励足以抵消对工人的损害。然而，此类政策对创新的因果效应仍是一个悬而未决的实证问题。利用各州竞业禁止协议可执行性看似外生的变化，我们发现其对创新产生了显著的负面影响。对于最具新颖性和创新性的专利及企业而言，这种负面效应甚至更大。进一步分析表明，这些对创新的负面影响无法仅用市场进入来解释，而更可能源于知识流动的减少。我们的研究结果表明，劳动力流动在跨企业知识传播中发挥着关键作用。

title: The Long-Run Effects of Monetary Policy
title_zh: 货币政策的长期效应
authors: Òscar Jordà, Sanjay R. Singh, Alan M. Taylor
abstract: We document that the real effects of monetary shocks last for over a decade. Our approach relies on identification of exogenous and nonsystematic monetary shocks using the trilemma of international finance; merged data from two new international historical cross-country databases; and econometric methods robust to long-horizon inconsistent estimates. Notably, the capital stock and total factor productivity exhibit greater hysteresis than labor. When we allow for asymmetry, we find these effects with tightening shocks but not with loosening shocks. When extending the horizon of the responses reported in several recent studies that use alternative monetary shocks, we find similarly persistent real effects, thus supporting our main findings.
abstract_zh: 我们证明，货币冲击的实际效应持续超过十年。我们的研究方法依赖于利用国际金融三难困境识别外生且非系统性的货币冲击；整合自两个新型国际历史跨国数据库的合并数据；以及能够应对长期估计不一致性的计量经济学方法。值得注意的是，资本存量与全要素生产率比劳动力表现出更强的滞后效应。在考虑非对称性时，我们发现紧缩性冲击会产生这些效应，而宽松性冲击则不会。当将近期多项采用替代性货币冲击的研究所报告的反应期限延长后，我们同样观察到持续的实际效应，从而佐证了我们的核心发现。

title: Healthcare access and human capital: evidence from Medicaid expansion
title_zh: 医疗可及性与人力资本：来自医疗补助扩展的证据
authors: Annabel Qiu
abstract: This paper investigates whether healthcare access affects educational achievement, exploiting the staggered ACA Medicaid expansion. Using county-level panel data on ACT scores, insurance coverage, and health indicators for 2012–2024, I find that Medicaid expansion raised county-level ACT composite scores by 0.50 to 0.85 points (about 0.22 standard deviations in the controlled specification). A Callaway and Sant’anna heterogeneity-robust estimator yields a simple aggregated ATT of 0.79, indicating the result is not an artefact of forbidden comparisons, and an event study is consistent with parallel pre-trends, with effects building to approximately 1.3 points by 6 years that I read as a suggestive long-run trajectory. The estimate attenuates and loses significance under within-region and within-division comparison and under relative-magnitude pre-trend violations, so I interpret it as suggestive of a causal effect under the design’s identifying assumptions rather than a firmly established magnitude. A supplementary instrumental-variables specification is consistent in sign but imprecise. A selection test does not detect changes in test participation, and channel analysis finds that observable health and economic indicators do not meaningfully mediate the effect, leaving the mechanism an open question for future research with individual-level data.
abstract_zh: 本文利用《平价医疗法案》下各州分阶段实施的医疗补助扩展政策，探究医疗可及性是否影响教育成就。基于2012–2024年县级面板数据（涵盖ACT成绩、保险覆盖率及健康指标），研究发现医疗补助扩展使县级ACT综合成绩提升0.50至0.85分（在控制规范中约为0.22个标准差）。采用Callaway与Sant'anna提出的异质性稳健估计量，得到简单汇总的平均处理效应（ATT）为0.79，表明该结果并非由禁止性比较造成的人为现象；事件研究支持平行趋势假设，且效应在6年内累积至约1.3分，可视为长期趋势的提示性证据。在区域内部及分区内部比较中，以及相对幅度事前趋势违反条件下，估计值减弱并失去显著性，因此本文将其解读为在设计识别假设下具有因果效应的提示性证据，而非确凿的效应量级。辅助工具变量估计在符号上一致但精度不足。选择检验未发现考试参与率变化，渠道分析表明可观测的健康与经济指标并未显著中介该效应，其作用机制有待未来基于个体层面数据的研究进一步探索。

title: Global Working Hours
title_zh: 全球工时
authors: Amory Gethin, Emmanuel Saez
abstract: This article uses labor force surveys from 160 countries to build a new microdatabase on hours worked covering 97% of the world population in cross section. We also construct time series spanning over 20 years in 86 countries. Hours worked per adult slightly decline with GDP per capita but are weakly correlated with development overall. Hours worked by the young (aged 15–19) and elderly (aged 60+) fall with development, driven entirely by growing school attendance and public pension coverage. Hours worked among prime-age adults (aged 20–59) are stable with development but undergo a great gender reshuffling: falling hours per male worker have been exactly offset by increases in female labor force participation in many countries. Labor income taxes are strongly negatively related to hours worked across countries. This correlation is attenuated when controlling for social spending and disappears when further controlling for working hours regulations. Both social spending and working hours regulations are associated with lower hours worked.
abstract_zh: 本文利用来自160个国家的劳动力调查，构建了一个覆盖全球97%人口的工时微观数据库（横截面数据）。同时，我们建立了涵盖86个国家、跨度超过20年的时间序列数据。成年人平均工时随人均GDP增长略有下降，但总体而言与经济发展水平的相关性较弱。青少年（15-19岁）和老年人（60岁以上）的工时随经济发展而减少，这完全是由入学率和公共养老金覆盖率的提高所驱动的。壮年劳动力（20-59岁）的工时随经济发展保持稳定，但经历了显著的性别结构重组：在许多国家，男性工人工时的下降恰好被女性劳动参与率的上升所抵消。劳动所得税与各国工时呈显著负相关。当控制社会支出后，这一相关性减弱；进一步控制工时法规后，该相关性消失。社会支出和工时法规均与较低的工时水平相关。

title: Online Benefit Redemption and SNAP Participation: Evidence From the SNAP Online Purchasing Pilot
title_zh: 在线福利兑换与SNAP参与：来自SNAP在线购买试点的证据
authors: Chaebeen Yoon, Xiaowei Zhang, Qingxiao Li
abstract: The Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) is the largest federal nutrition assistance program in the United States, yet many eligible households do not participate due to administrative burdens, stigma, and geographic access constraints. We examine whether the SNAP Online Purchasing Pilot (OPP), which allows beneficiaries to redeem benefits online, affects program participation. Using a difference‐in‐differences design with state‐level data from 2017 to 2021, we find that SNAP OPP increases program participation per capita by 13.7% (1.6 percentage points) and participation among individuals below the poverty line by 11.3% (11 percentage points). Event‐study estimates indicate effects emerge within three months and persist thereafter. Participation gains are larger in states with higher digital infrastructure (computer ownership and internet access) and greater vehicle access, indicating that online and physical access function as complements. States with higher shares of elderly residents and households with children also exhibit stronger responses. These findings suggest that enabling online benefit redemption can expand safety net access, though benefits vary systematically with local infrastructure and demographic composition.
abstract_zh: 补充营养援助计划（SNAP）是美国最大的联邦营养援助项目，但由于行政负担、污名化以及地理可达性限制，许多符合条件的家庭并未参与其中。我们考察了SNAP在线购买试点项目（OPP）——该试点允许受益人通过在线方式兑换福利——是否会影响项目参与率。利用2017年至2021年的州级数据，采用双重差分法进行分析，我们发现SNAP OPP使人均项目参与率提高了13.7%（1.6个百分点），贫困线以下个体的参与率提高了11.3%（11个百分点）。事件研究估计表明，该效应在三个月内显现并持续存在。在数字基础设施（计算机拥有率和互联网接入率）更完善以及车辆可及性更高的州，参与率增幅更大，这表明在线与实体可达性具有互补作用。老年居民比例较高以及有儿童家庭比例较高的州也表现出更强的响应。这些发现表明，允许在线福利兑换能够扩大安全网的可及性，但其效益会因当地基础设施和人口结构的差异而呈现系统性变化。

title: Racial Disparities in Federal Sentencing: Evidence from Drug Mandatory Minimums
title_zh: 联邦量刑中的种族差异：来自毒品强制最低刑期的证据
authors: Cody Tuttle
abstract: I study racial disparities in the criminal justice system by analysing abnormal bunching in the distribution of crack-cocaine amounts used in federal sentencing. I compare cases sentenced before and after the Fair Sentencing Act, a 2010 law that changed the 10-year mandatory minimum threshold for crack-cocaine from 50 g to 280 g. First, I find that after 2010, there is a sharp increase in the fraction of cases sentenced at 280 g (the point that now triggers a 10-year mandatory minimum), and that this increase is disproportionately large for black and Hispanic offenders. I then explore several possible explanations for the observed racial disparities, including racial discrimination that occurs after entry into the criminal justice system. I analyse data from multiple stages in the criminal justice system and find that the increased bunching for minority offenders is driven by prosecutorial discretion, specifically as used by about 20–30% of prosecutors. Moreover, the fraction of cases at 280 g falls in 2013 when evidentiary standards become stricter. Finally, the racial disparity in the increase cannot be explained by differences in education, sex, age, criminal history, seized drug amount, or other elements of the crime, but it can be largely explained by a measure of state-level racial animus. These results shed light on the role of prosecutorial discretion and racial discrimination as causes of racial disparities in sentencing.
abstract_zh: 本文通过分析联邦量刑中快克可卡因数量分布的异常聚集现象，研究刑事司法体系中的种族差异。我将2010年《公平量刑法》实施前后判决的案件进行对比——该法案将触发10年强制最低刑期的快克可卡因门槛从50克调整为280克。首先发现，2010年后以280克（当前触发10年强制最低刑期的临界点）量刑的案件比例急剧上升，且黑人及西班牙裔罪犯在此增幅中占比显著偏高。随后探讨了导致观察到的种族差异的几种可能解释，包括进入刑事司法体系后发生的种族歧视。通过分析刑事司法体系多个阶段的数据，发现少数族裔罪犯的聚集现象加剧源于检察官的自由裁量权，具体表现为约20-30%检察官的裁量行为。此外，当2013年证据标准趋严时，280克量刑案件比例出现下降。最后，这种增幅中的种族差异无法通过教育程度、性别、年龄、犯罪前科、毒品查获数量或其他犯罪要素来解释，但可在很大程度上由州级种族敌意指标解释。这些研究结果揭示了检察官自由裁量权与种族歧视作为量刑种族差异成因的作用机制。

title: Gendered Capability Deprivation in Early Childhood: Evidence from Four MENA Countries
title_zh: 早期儿童性别能力剥夺：来自四个中东和北非国家的证据
authors: Abu-Zaineh, Mohammad, Yousef, Sahar F.
official: 官方在线 2026-05-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This article examines gender differences in early childhood capability deprivation in Algeria, Morocco, Syria, and Yemen. Using nationally representative surveys from the Pan Arab Project for Family Health, we estimate deprivation among children aged 0-4 in three latent dimensions: nutrition, sanitation, and access to information. The empirical strategy combines a capability-deprivation framework with multi-group structural equation modelling, measurement-invariance tests, and multidimensional aggregation. The results show that gendered deprivation is neither uniform nor always to the disadvantage of girls. Female children are more likely to be capability deprived on aggregate in Algeria, Morocco, and Yemen, while male children appear more deprived in Syria. Gender disparities also vary across dimensions: boys are more likely to be nutrition-deprived in Morocco and Syria, while girls are more likely to be sanitation-deprived in Algeria and Morocco and information-deprived in Morocco and Yemen. Rural residence and low household-head education are generally associated with weaker achievements in nutrition, sanitation, and information. The findings contribute to applied research on child poverty measurement and gender inequality by showing that gendered capability deprivation is observable before school age and is patterned by household and public-service conditions.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了阿尔及利亚、摩洛哥、叙利亚和也门四国儿童早期能力剥夺的性别差异。基于泛阿拉伯家庭健康项目的全国代表性调查数据，我们估算了0-4岁儿童在营养、卫生设施和信息获取三个潜在维度上的剥夺状况。实证策略将能力剥夺框架与多组结构方程模型、测量不变性检验及多维聚合方法相结合。研究结果表明：性别化的剥夺既非均匀分布，也并非总是不利于女童。在阿尔及利亚、摩洛哥和也门，女童在综合指标上更易遭受能力剥夺，而叙利亚男童的剥夺程度则更为显著。性别差异在不同维度上呈现异质性：摩洛哥和叙利亚男童更易出现营养剥夺，阿尔及利亚和摩洛哥女童更易面临卫生设施剥夺，摩洛哥和也门女童则在信息获取方面处于劣势。农村居住环境与户主低教育水平通常与营养、卫生设施及信息获取方面的弱势表现相关。本研究通过揭示学龄前阶段已存在性别化的能力剥夺现象，且该现象受家庭与公共服务条件影响，为儿童贫困测量与性别不平等领域的应用研究提供了新证据。

title: Stochastic volatility in mean: Efficient analysis by a generalized mixture sampler
title_zh: 均值随机波动率：基于广义混合抽样器的高效分析
authors: Daichi Hiraki, Siddhartha Chib, Yasuhiro Omori
abstract: In this paper we consider the simulation-based Bayesian analysis of stochastic volatility in mean (SVM) models. Extending the highly efficient Markov chain Monte Carlo mixture sampler for the SV model proposed in Kim et al. (1998) and Omori et al. (2007), we develop an accurate approximation of the logarithm of the non-central chi-squared distribution as a mixture of thirty normal distributions . Under this mixture representation, we sample the parameters and latent volatilities in one block. We also detail a correction of the small approximation error by using additional Metropolis–Hastings steps. The proposed method is extended to the SVM model with leverage. The methodology and models are applied to excess holding yields and S&P500 returns in empirical studies, and the SVM models are shown to outperform other volatility models based on marginal likelihoods.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了基于模拟的贝叶斯分析在随机波动率均值（SVM）模型中的应用。通过扩展Kim等人（1998）及Omori等人（2007）提出的针对SV模型的高效马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛混合抽样方法，我们开发了一种精确近似非中心卡方分布对数的方法，将其表示为三十个正态分布的混合形式。在此混合表示下，我们实现了参数与潜在波动率的联合分块抽样。同时，我们详细阐述了通过附加Metropolis-Hastings步骤来修正微小近似误差的方法，并将所提方法扩展至包含杠杆效应的SVM模型。在实证研究中，我们将该方法与模型应用于超额持有收益率及标普500指数收益率，结果表明基于边际似然比较，SVM模型优于其他波动率模型。
